hero.headline: Professional Pool Management Made Simple
hero.subheadline: AquaSense helps swimming pool operators streamline operations, manage staff, and ensure safety with ease.

story.title: Your Day with AquaSense
story.subtitle: Follow the operational journey from morning setup to closing time

morning.title: Morning Setup
morning.description: Start your day with automated checklists and equipment checks. AquaSense guides you through essential safety procedures and water quality testing, ensuring everything is ready before opening.

daytime.title: Daytime Operations
daytime.description: Monitor pool operations in real-time with live dashboards. Track visitor counts, water chemistry, and staff schedules from any device. Stay informed and responsive throughout the day.

incident.title: Incident Handling
incident.description: Quickly document and respond to any incidents with our mobile-friendly reporting system. Capture photos, record details, and notify management instantly for swift resolution.

closing.title: Closing Procedures
closing.description: Complete end-of-day tasks efficiently with guided closing checklists. Record final readings, secure equipment, and generate automated reports for tomorrow's team.
